t: You're standing by the Jubilee Fountain in New Palace Yard, just outside the Houses of Parliament. It was put up to commemorate the Silver Jubilee of Elizabeth the Second. The sculptor is Walenty Pytel, a Polish-born artist based in the United Kingdom, recognised as a leading metal sculptor of birds and beasts. So as you look at the fountain, it's worth noticing the metalwork closely, because that is his speciality.
